title: Data source research candidate
description: One evaluated candidate produced by the research-sources procedure. File name is research/candidates/<slug>.json.

slug.description: kebab-case id, matches the file name

granularity.description: e.g. tract, ZCTA, county, MSA, state, national

login_required.description: account/API key signup, distinct from a paywall

commercial_use_clear.description: false if ToS language is ambiguous or restrictive

cost.description: should be 'free' after confirming license.free; note any rate limit here

gap_addressed.description: what existing coverage gap or hardcoded assumption this fills

correlation.description: null if app/research/evaluate_series.py doesn't exist yet (quantitative step skipped)
